## STEP 1 — Master Directory Structure

```
ws/
├── index.html                     # Vite entry: <div id="app"> + <div id="ui-root">,
│                                  # one import line → active game's main.js (switch games by editing this line)
├── package.json                   # three (pinned) + vite (dev) — nothing else
├── vite.config.js                 # bare config, no plugins
│
├── shared/                        # Reusable across the entire 14-game collection.
│   │                               # One-way dependency: shared/ NEVER imports from a game folder.
│   ├── core/
│   │   ├── Engine.js              # Renderer, scene, camera, clock, clamped-delta loop,
│   │   │                          # resize handling, full dispose() (walks scene graph,
│   │   │                          # disposes geometry/material/texture)
│   │   ├── Input.js               # Unified dual-input: Keyboard (WASD/arrows) + Gamepad API.
│   │   │                          # Normalized axes, deadzone, edge-triggered buttons,
│   │   │                          # identical query API regardless of source
│   │   ├── TimeScale.js           # Global time-dilation factor (hit-stop / slow-mo),
│   │   │                          # eased recovery — Engine multiplies delta by it
│   │   └── ObjectPool.js          # Generic pre-allocated pool: acquire/release,
│   │                              # zero per-frame allocation in hot paths
│   ├── vfx/                       # The six required shared VFX, all pooled
│   │   ├── CameraShake.js         # Trauma-based (0→1), decaying, offset ∝ trauma²,
│   │   │                          # impact-velocity scaling
│   │   ├── ParticleManager.js     # Single InstancedMesh, HARD CAP 500 live particles,
│   │   │                          # ring-buffer allocation, per-particle vel/life/color/size
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRings.js      # Pooled expanding emissive rings (RingGeometry)
│   │   ├── MotionTrails.js        # Pooled fading ribbon segments for fast movers
│   │   └── FloatingText.js        # DOM score text, projected from world coords,
│   │                              # CSS-animated rise/fade
│   ├── audio/
│   │   ├── AudioEngine.js         # Web Audio graph: master bus, synth voices
│   │   │                          # (osc → filter → envelope), 100% procedural SFX
│   │   └── MusicSequencer.js      # Lookahead-scheduled step sequencer, procedural
│   │                              # retro-futurist tracks (no audio files)
│   ├── postfx/
│   │   └── Composer.js            # EffectComposer + RenderPass + UnrealBloomPass,
│   │                              # tuned (threshold/strength/radius) so emissives
│   │                              # glow without washing to white
│   ├── ui/
│   │   ├── GlassUI.js             # Glassmorphism HUD + menu/pause/game-over screens,
│   │   │                          # neon accent system, slot-based API
│   │   └── glass.css              # Design tokens: backdrop blur, translucency,
│   │                              # glow shadows, typography
│   └── utils/
│       ├── Math.js                # clamp, lerp, damp, randRange, angleLerp, etc.
│       └── Procedural.js          # Canvas-API texture generation (glow sprites,
│                                  # grid floors, panel faces) + layered-sine/value noise
│
└── [GameName]/                    # Exactly one of the 14, directory named exactly
    ├── main.js                    # Bootstrap: construct shared/* + game, wire loop,
    │                              # handle shutdown/dispose
    ├── config.js                  # Every tunable constant in one place
    ├── [GameName]Game.js          # State machine: menu → playing ⇄ paused → gameover
    ├── entities/                  # Pooled gameplay objects (player, projectiles,
    │                              # hazards, pickups) — each uses ObjectPool
    └── systems/                   # Hand-written collision (circle/SAT), spawner,
                                   # scoring — no physics libraries
```

**Import graph (strict, one-way):**

```
index.html ──► [GameName]/main.js ──► [GameName]/* ──► ../shared/* ──► three, three/addons/*
```

- `three/addons/*` resolves via three's package exports (EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass) — no bundler aliasing needed under Vite.
- `shared/` is game-agnostic: it exposes capabilities (pool, particles, shake, audio, UI), never game rules. Any of the 14 games drops into the same skeleton.
- Switching games = one import line in `index.html`; no path surgery.

**Vite setup:** hand-written `package.json` (pinned `three`, dev `vite`), `vite.config.js`, `index.html`. No scaffolding tool, no extra dependencies, no lockfile churn.

---

### Compliance

- **Anti-Lazy Directive:** Every function will be fully implemented — no `// ... rest of function`, no stubs, no "wired up later" comments. If a file's output truncates, I stop mid-file and resume at the exact character on "continue".
- **Strict Memory Management:** All projectiles/entities/particles come from pre-allocated pools; the particle system is hard-capped at 500 via the centralized `ParticleManager`; `Engine.dispose()` walks the scene graph and explicitly `.dispose()`s every geometry, material, and canvas texture; zero per-frame allocations in hot loops (reused vectors, no string concatenation in `update`).
- **Sequential Output Protocol:** One game at a time, in the order you name. The `shared/` layer is written to be collection-reusable, but I will implement **only** the game you command — no speculative siblings.
